title: pleroma glutinosum
intro: Pleroma glutinosum, commonly known as the "Pleurotus", is a type of edible mushroom that belongs to the family Psathyrellaceae. The health benefits of Pleroma glutinosum include its potential to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and lower cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of Pleroma glutinosum include polysaccharides, polyphenols, and other antioxidants that contribute to its medicinal properties.
